title: CR-1: Modifies U.S. note 2(aa)(v)(1) to subchapter III of chapter 99.

title: CR-2: Modifies U.S. note 16(a) through (c) to subchapter III of chapter 99.

summary.summary: U.S. note 16(a), (b) and (c) of subchapter III now cover headings 9903.82.02 through 9903.82.19 instead of through 9903.82.17. Two new headings, 9903.82.18 and 9903.82.19, therefore fall under the note's rules: mutual exclusivity, collection in addition to FTA or preference rates, the chapter 98 and 9802.00.60 full-value rule, and assessment on full customs value of listed articles. The 15 percent metal-weight threshold for articles outside chapters 72, 73, 74 and 76 was not extended and still names only 9903.82.02 and 9903.82.04–9903.82.17. In the derivative aluminum list (c)(ii), 7612.10.10 was replaced by 7612.10.00. The other differences are punctuation and spacing only.

title: CR-4: Adds U.S. note 16(h) and (i) to subchapter III of chapter 99.

summary.summary: Two new subdivisions, U.S. note 16(h) and 16(i), set up reduced-duty Section 232 headings under Proclamation 10984 (October 17, 2025). Heading 9903.82.18 covers note 16(c)(iii) steel articles that were melted and poured in Canada or Mexico. Heading 9903.82.19 covers note 16(c)(i) aluminum articles that were smelted and cast in Canada or Mexico. Goods qualify only if they are USMCA-originating under general note 11, are limited quantities, and the Secretary of Commerce has authorized them for the reduction. The material does not state the reduced rate for either heading, so the duty owed cannot be determined from this diff. Importers must also supply whatever information CBP requires.

summary.engine_impact: Add 9903.82.18 and 9903.82.19 as alternative Section 232 headings. Apply 9903.82.18 only to note 16(c)(iii) steel codes and 9903.82.19 only to note 16(c)(i) aluminum codes. Gate selection on all of the following: (a) country of melt/pour (steel) or smelt/cast (aluminum) is Canada or Mexico; (b) the good qualifies for USMCA preference under general note 11; (c) an importer-supplied flag that Commerce has authorized the quantity, since the calculator cannot verify authorization or quota balance. Under note 16(a) these headings are mutually exclusive with 9903.82.02–9903.82.17, so the engine should select only one. Under note 16(b) the 232 duty still stacks on the USMCA special rate. The note 16(c) 15% metal-weight rule names only 9903.82.02 and 9903.82.04–9903.82.17. That is moot here because all (c)(i) and (c)(iii) codes are in chapters 72, 73 and 76. The reduced rate must be taken from the heading lines, which are not in this diff.
